I give up. I can't produce a proof of this theorem with the tools and time available.

The statement is Kunz's theorem: for a reduced Noetherian local ring of characteristic p, Frobenius is flat if and only if the ring is regular. Mathlib has no version of it. I searched the compiled Mathlib build for `Kunz` and `RegularLocalRing` and found nothing. Proving it would mean formalizing a substantial part of commutative algebra from scratch, including flatness criteria over Noetherian local rings and the regularity arguments in both directions. That is far beyond a proof I can finish here.

I did not modify `/work/fatex_043.lean`, so it still contains the `sorry`.
